outcome: preeclampsia or eclampsia superimposed on pre-existing hypertension
cohort: The study analyzed 137,303 multiple pregnancies from an American population database, categorized into obese (6761) and non-obese (130,542) groups.
finding: Obesity in women with multiple gestations significantly increases the risk of various maternal, delivery, and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Obese women with multiple gestations were more likely to have caesarean deliveries.
